description: CCF shared Renovate preset: third-party dependencies only (ccf-bump owns compliance-framework ones). Branches are rebased only on conflicts (rebaseWhen), so one run merges every green PR. See docs/renovate.md.

packageRules.description: Runtime changes ship in a release, so they are fix(deps): the final image stage and the Go toolchain, on top of :semanticPrefixFixDepsChoreOthers (require/dependencies).
One PR per repo for every non-major update (Go toolchain and golang image included), merged by Renovate as ccf-release-bot on its next run once the required check passes.
Majors open a PR for a human.
OPA follows the api via ccf-bump everywhere else (agent, policy and plugin repos), so Renovate leaves it alone there.
In the api, OPA gets its own PR and never auto-merges: a bump forces agent and the policies to follow.
Internal packages, images and reusable workflows are ccf-bump's, so the two tools never fight over a version.
